named_differences.DIFF-NIBBLE: DV-Router reads the length nibble of 0x3x blocks (0x30..0x35, 0 means 5, 0x36..0x3F dropped), DStarGateway ignores it and adds 5 bytes per block
named_differences.DIFF-GPS-LIMIT: DV-Router limits a D-PRS sentence to 300 bytes including the CR and an NMEA line to 82 bytes before the delimiter, DStarGateway has no limit
named_differences.DIFF-PAIR-HOLE: DV-Router pairs fixed frames (1,2)..(19,20) of a unit, a hole skips one block; the oracles pair the frames they receive in turn, so a lost frame shifts their pairing until the next sync

unit66: unit66_hex: one string per superframe unit (a new unit starts when the frame number does not increase): 3 byte presence bitmap + 21 x 3 raw slow data bytes as received (frame 0 included, others scrambled; an absent frame is 3 zero bytes). Bitmap bit order is the generator's ASSUMPTION: 24 bit big-endian, MSB first over frames 0..20, frame f = bit (23 - f), the 3 spare low bits zero.
